notes.title: 2025.3.13 Updates
notes.content:
[h2][b]New Adds[/b][/h2]

[olist]
[*] Supported [Steam Deck]. There may be some compatibility issues, please contact us if you have any problems
[*] Added extra strategies in the [Pre-battle Deployment] interface. Now players can perform the following actions:

[list]
[*] Enable/Disable skill auto-cast for each [Hero], Shortcut Key [G]
[*] Set the initial state for each [Hero] team, including [Standby],  [Follow],  and [Speed Sync]
[*] Choose the default controlled [Hero]
[/list]These settings will be saved for the next battle
You can also enable/disable skill auto-cast for each [Hero] during battle, but this setting will not be saved for the next battle

[*] Added [Speed Up] button during story scenes, Shortcut Key [K]
[*] Added new movement method on the world map—hold mouse [Left Button] or [Right Button] to move, no need to click ground. This mode is invalid in battle
[*] Added [Enter] confirm function, e.g., When you purchase the item in [Shop], press [Enter] to directly purchase
[/olist]

[h2][b]Issue Fixes[/b][/h2]

[olist]
[*] Fixed the issue where some [Abilities] were not properly affected or applied in the game
[*] Fixed the issue where the game would crash in certain circumstances, please contact us if this issue persists
[*] Fixed the issue where the abnormal City [Income] and high cost of "Strong"  garrison
[*] Fixed the issue where some [Skills] effects were not properly applied
[*] Optimized the issue of [Ranged Hero]'s hit rate was too low
[/olist]

[h2][b]Adjustments[/b][/h2]

[olist]
[*] Adjusted hero [Deng Zhiqiu], [He Siren] talents and abilities
[*] Adjusted soldier [Blade Handler] ability, now the number requirement will no longer need to count the total number, it will count [Blade Handler] number only
[/olist]

notes.title: 2025.2.27 Patch
notes.content:
[h1][b]Issue Fixes [/b][/h1]
[olist]
[*] Fixed the issue where using [Crossbow] and [Gun] on horseback could not properly hit targets.
[*] Fixed the issue where that prevented saving in certain circumstances.
[*] Fixed the issue where NPCs would improperly overlap with construction in some locations, making interaction difficult. 
[/olist]
[h1][b]Content Adjustments [/b][/h1]
[olist]
[*] Enhanced the talent trees of [Commander] and [Martial Artist].
[*] Added [Gun] in the equipment required for Skill-[Hunting Ecstasy]. 
[*] Optimized the [Hundred Refinements Gate] challenge difficulty.
[*] Optimized the rewards of [Hundred Refinements Gate] challenge, now Level 4 will obtain [Sect Disciple], Level 7 will obtain [Zhao-Yang Sword Guard], and Level  9 will obtain additional equipment rewards.
[*] Increased [Medical Hall] recovery amount to 2 times.
[*] Increased the price of [Snacks] and improved the Legion's recovery efficiency.
[*] Adjusted the  some tiles' attack strategy in pre-battle deployment .
[/olist]

notes.title: 2025.2.25 Patch
notes.content:
[Issue Fixes]
1. Fixed the issue where hostile factions would improperly become peace with players, and display improper name colors 
2. Fixed the issue where some typos
3. Fixed some known issues

[Content Adjustments]
1. Adjusted Deng Zhiqiu's initial talents, adding the "Charge" Skill to the talent tree
2. Added [Gun] in [Lao-Chen] for sale

[New Content]
1. Introduced the new boss [The God of Sin Seth]. Players can challenge it at [Dragon Bridge] now.
